Principal Electro-Acoustic Engineer

Denmark

Smørum

Senior or Principal Electro-Acoustic Engineer

Device Hardware (DHW) · Styles & Engine Electro-Acoustics · Smørum, Denmark

Would you like to engage in meaningful work five days a week? A career where your engineering contributes to the quality of life for people worldwide? Then you have found the right place. We are looking for a Senior or Principal Electro-Acoustic Engineer to join Device Hardware in R&D – a broad, hands-on engineer who can shape how we design, measure and verify the sound of tomorrow's hearing instruments, and who inspires the people around them.

Our R&D department embraces the whole circle of development in-house, from early concept maturation to product launch and beyond.

Join the Electro-Acoustics team

You will join the DHW Styles & Engine Electro-Acoustics team, a group of electro-acoustic engineers responsible for the design and verification of the electro-acoustic concepts in our hearing instrument platforms. We work in agile teams within our Agile Release Train (ART), in close collaboration with mechanical, electronics, firmware, audiology and test-system colleagues.

Your role

We are looking for a colleague with deep electro-acoustic expertise who is equally comfortable working across the whole acoustic system, the measurement chain and the development process. You will:

• Drive acoustic system design and development of new hearing instrument platforms and styles – from concept maturation to product release

• Own and evolve electro-acoustic specifications and requirements, and translate them into robust design proposals together with mechanics, electronics and firmware

• Select and qualify transducers (microphones, receivers/speakers) and work with suppliers on performance

• Define platform calibration and settings, and secure a good signal path and feedback margin at system level

• Test, verify and document the electro-acoustic performance of HW platforms, and continuously improve our measurement methods, setups and tools

• Contribute to the development of our measurements & tools – measurement systems and labs, internal software tools and measurement methods – in close collaboration with test systems and tool development teams.

• Act as a technical sparring partner and mentor for colleagues, share knowledge across teams, and help raise the technical bar of the team

Agile mindset and inspiration

We work in SAFe. We expect that you have practical experience working in agile/SAFe (or similar) development and you genuinely believe in it. You take part in PI planning with confidence, break down work into features and stories, are transparent about progress and risks, and help the team improve continuously. Your mindset, energy and way of working make you a natural role model and an inspiration for both senior and junior colleagues.

Your profile

We expect you to have:

• A B.Sc. or M.Sc.  in Engineering with a degree in Acoustics / Engineering Acoustics / Electro-acoustics

• Typically, 6+ years of professional experience in electro-acoustic or acoustic product development

• Strong foundation in acoustic measurements, transducers, sound quality, vibro-acoustics and sound path design

• Acoustic or vibro-acoustic simulation (e.g. lumped-element models, FEM/BEM – ANSYS or similar)

• Knowledge of electro-acoustic standards (e.g. IEC 60118 / ANSI S3.22), test systems and calibration

• Experience with Python and/or MATLAB for measurement automation, data analysis and tool development

• Experience with signal processing, electronics or system integration

• Hands-on experience with agile/SAFe ways of working and the mindset to drive and inspire a team within it

• Fluent written and spoken English

Hearing aid experience is a requirement. Experience from a similar industry at the same seniority or responsibility level where sound quality, size and power budgets matter at the same time is just as relevant.

Who you are

As a person, you are proud of your profession, curious and a team player at heart. You see the whole system and enjoy connecting the dots across disciplines. You communicate clearly with specialists and management alike, you enjoy networking in a delivery-driven, cross-functional organisation, and you take ownership – of your own deliveries as well as the team's success. You perform best in a vibrant atmosphere where you can share your experience and keep learning from others.

How to apply

Please send us your application and CV as soon as possible and no later than December 4th, 2026. Please note that we only accept applications through our online recruitment system. We are curious to meet you!

We evaluate applications on an ongoing basis and will invite candidates for interviews continuously, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

The first round of interviews is expected the 10th and the 11th of December and the second round the 18th December.

If you would like to know more about the position, you are very welcome to contact Manager, DHW Styles & Engine Electro-Acoustics, Maria Chantziara, at mzic@demant.com.

We are looking forward to hearing from you.

At Demant we value diversity, equity and inclusion (DE&I) and we are committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnic background, personality, age, gender, and education. Diversity is part of our cultural DNA. Women in STEM areas are particularly encouraged to apply, as Demant supports United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5 on gender equality.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Patent Attorney to play a central role in protecting and enabling innovation across Demant's global business and help shape the future of our Intellectual Property function.

In this role, you will partner closely with R&D teams, engineers, scientists, and business stakeholders to ensure that Demant continues to develop and launch innovative products with the lowest possible litigation risk. You will contribute to the growth and strengthening of our international patent portfolio while providing strategic IP guidance that supports our business ambitions.

This role requires more than technical expertise and patent law knowledge. It requires curiosity, commercial understanding, good stakeholder management, and the ability to translate complex technologies into valuable intellectual property. This is where you come in.

Welcome to Demant Intellectual Property

You will join Demant's Intellectual Property team at our Demant headquarters in Smørum, just outside Copenhagen, and become part of a highly skilled and collaborative team consisting of Patent Attorneys, Trademark Attorneys, and IP Paralegals.

Demant is a growing, world-leading hearing healthcare corporation that offers solutions in hearing devices, diagnostic instruments, and intelligent audio and video equipment. Through innovative technologies and deep expertise, we are dedicated to making life-changing differences for people with hearing loss around the world.

Our team consists of 14 colleagues from several different nationalities and professional backgrounds. We believe that results are achieved through collaboration and knowledge-sharing. We actively support one another, provide constructive feedback, and continuously develop our collective expertise in both technology and intellectual property.

Working closely with globally distributed business units and R&D organizations, our primary purpose is to help ensure that Demant's products can successfully reach the market while minimizing intellectual property risks.

Help protect the innovations of tomorrow

Joining us, you will bring an intellectual property perspective to strategic technology decisions and help researchers, engineers, and business leaders navigate an increasingly complex innovation landscape.

A key part of your role will be identifying opportunities and risks early in the development process and helping stakeholders answer critical questions: Are we free to commercialize this technology? How can we strengthen our competitive position? How can we protect our innovations globally? And how do we build an IP portfolio that supports Demant's long-term business strategy?

You will work across the boundaries of technology, law, and business, helping transform ideas into protected innovations while supporting product and technology development from concept to market launch.

In this role, you will

• Support innovation throughout the product lifecycle – Participate in R&D project groups and provide IP guidance throughout the development process and help teams make informed technology and business decisions.

• Drive freedom-to-operate activities – Conduct analyses and provide strategic advice to ensure products can be launched with the lowest possible litigation risk.

• Expand and strengthen Demant's patent portfolio – Evaluate invention disclosures, identify patentable innovations, and actively contribute to the growth of our international patent portfolio.

• Manage patent drafting and prosecution – Prepare, file, and prosecute patent applications in multiple jurisdictions while working closely with inventors and external partners.

• Analyze competitor patents – Prepare, file, and present at opposition proceedings before the European Patent Office

• Develop intellectual property expertise – Contribute to the team's collective knowledge within technology and patent law while continuously expanding your own professional capabilities.

By joining Demant, you will step into a highly visible role where your ability to connect technology, intellectual property, and business strategy will directly support innovation and help protect products that improve the lives of people across the world.

What You Bring

You have a scientific or technical background combined with practical intellectual property experience and a genuine interest in understanding how innovation creates business value.

You bring:

• Qualification as a European Patent Attorney or as a US Patent Attorney.

• 5+ years of experience within intellectual property, gained either in industry, private practice, or a combination of both.

• A scientific or technical degree, preferably within physics, electronics, or a related field.

• Excellent analytical capabilities and the ability to quickly understand new technologies and technical concepts.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex IP matters clearly to a broad range of stakeholders.

• A structured and systematic approach combined with strong attention to detail.

• An interest in understanding business needs and translating them into effective IP strategies.

Finally, you are curious, collaborative, and enjoy working closely with experts across different disciplines. You combine technical depth with commercial awareness, build trusted relationships with stakeholders, and are motivated by helping innovation succeed.

Flexible Working Conditions

At Demant, we work in a collaborative environment built on trust, openness, and strong professional relationships. Networking and knowledge-sharing are essential parts of how we work.

We offer you flexible working conditions, excellent opportunities for professional development, and a highly skilled team that works towards a common goal. From the moment you enter our premises, you will experience Demant's energizing and welcoming spirit.

Join our diverse organization and work alongside colleagues from many different nationalities and backgrounds while contributing to technologies that make a meaningful difference in people's lives.

Come and join us

Please submit your application as soon as possible and no later than December 13, 2026.

Please note that we only accept applications submitted through our online recruitment system.

If you would like to know more about the position, you are welcome to contact Director of Patents & Designs, Daniel Fischer, via email at dajf@demant.com.

We are curious to meet you.

Recruitment Process Information

If you think role is exiting, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible, since we will be inviting candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

Imagine joining a team at the very beginning. Not to maintain something others designed, but to shape what it becomes: the code, the platform, the way of working and the people around you. That is the opportunity in our Quality AI Enabler team.

We are a small team working where AI, cloud technology, software engineering, data and Quality meet. Experience from a regulated industry is an advantage, but curiosity matters more. Few places let you build this knowledge from the ground up. We are one such place.

You are a pragmatic builder who knows the difference between an impressive demo and a solution people can rely on. You enjoy experimenting, but you respect disciplined engineering. Job Description: Shape the future of data governance in one of the Nordic region's leading insurance companies.

Do you thrive at the intersection of technology and governance? Are you equally comfortable discussing access models with data engineers and governance frameworks with business stakeholders?

At Tryg, we're looking for a Data Platform Governance Architect who can bridge the gap between governance ambitions and technical reality, helping us build a scalable, secure, and trusted data platform that enables better decisions across the business.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have helped design, establish, or mature enterprise-scale data platforms and who understand what a well-functioning platform looks like from both a governance and architecture perspective.

About the role | Bridging governance, platform architecture and technology

As our new Data Platform Governance Architect, you will act as the technical bridge between our data governance and data platform teams. Your primary responsibility is to translate governance requirements into clear, actionable technical specifications while ensuring governance stakeholders understand platform capabilities, constraints, and trade-offs.

You will draw on your hands-on experience from data platform architecture, data platform engineering, data management, or governance roles to define robust, implementable governance requirements. You will also help design and implement governance processes and feedback loops. You will work closely with the platform team, which is responsible for implementing the technical solutions.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Defining governance requirements and frameworks for data access, classification, lineage, catalog structures, and tagging taxonomies

• Translating governance, compliance, and security requirements into clear technical specifications and platform controls

• Designing scalable access and operating models, including onboarding, approval workflows, roles, responsibilities, and ownership structures

• Advising on governance capabilities within Databricks, Unity Catalog, and cloud-based identity and access management solutions

• Aligning governance policies with platform implementation and producing governance documentation, access model designs, and process descriptions

• Advising and challenging stakeholders to embed governance into platform processes and enable efficient, governed data product delivery across teams and business domains

You will play a key role in embedding governance into our data platform landscape, working closely with experienced specialists across data, security, architecture, and governance to shape standards and practices that support the long-term strategic use of data throughout the organization. You will help ensure governance and compliance enable scalable data delivery rather than create bottlenecks as platform adoption grows.

About you | Platform architecture mindset and governance credibility

To succeed in this role, you combine strong governance thinking with a solid technical foundation. You understand how modern cloud-based enterprise data platforms are designed, established, and operated because you have helped build, evolve, or govern them in previous roles. You enjoy translating complexity into clarity and can confidently engage with both technical specialists and business stakeholders.

You will be most successful if you:

Must-have qualifications

• Have at least 4 years of experience within data platform architecture, data platform engineering, data governance, data management, or related disciplines, including experience contributing to the design, implementation, or evolution of an enterprise-scale data platform.

• Possess hands-on experience with Databricks and Unity Catalog, including RBAC, governance controls, catalog and schema structures, lineage, classification, tagging, and security capabilities.

• Understand cloud-based identity and access management, including Azure Entra ID, Active Directory, RBAC, ABAC, service principals, and storage permissions, and be able to translate governance requirements into clear, implementable technical specifications.

• Have experience designing and implementing governance models and processes for how data is onboarded, structured, accessed, governed, and delivered across a modern data platform.

• Have experience establishing operating models for data ownership, stewardship, and data product delivery, combined with strong stakeholder management and communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.

It is an advantage if you

• Have experience from a regulated industry, such as insurance, financial services, or healthcare, and have worked with GDPR, privacy requirements, access governance, or compliance controls within cloud-based data platforms.

• Have experience designing enterprise-wide data classification frameworks, tagging taxonomies, and scalable governance practices, where compliance requirements are embedded into platform capabilities and automated processes.

• Understand modern data architecture and platform automation, including medallion architecture, data products, domain-driven ownership models, infrastructure-as-code, GitLab, Terraform, and CI/CD practices.

• Hold relevant certifications, such as CDMP, DAMA, or Databricks certifications.

You are naturally collaborative, analytical, and pragmatic, with a talent for challenging assumptions and turning complexity into practical solutions. You understand how to balance risk, usability, and business value, embedding governance into the platform to enable trusted data delivery at scale.

Advanced Pilot Scientist

Måløv, Denmark

**

Your impact begins here

**Would you like to help ensure that drug products for clinical trials are manufactured to the right quality, at the right time, in close collaboration with manufacturing partners around the world?

As an Advanced Pilot Scientist in Outsourced Production, you will play an important role in connecting our Contract Manufacturing Organisations (CMOs) with Novo Nordisk. You will help ensure that manufacturing activities, documentation and batch reviews are handled efficiently and to the required quality standards, supporting clinical programmes as they move forward.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys taking ownership, reviewing documentation, solving problems and getting things done in a GMP-regulated production environment.

**

What you'll bring

**We are looking for someone who combines scientific understanding with a structured and delivery-focused mindset. You may already have a few years of experience from pharmaceutical production, QA or a similar area. We are also open to recent graduates who bring relevant academic knowledge, curiosity and a strong motivation to learn.

To succeed in the role, we imagine that you:

• Hold a relevant academic degree within pharmacy, engineering, science or a similar field.

• Bring experience with or strong knowledge of pharmaceutical production, preferably including aseptic or oral drug product manufacturing.

• Ideally have experience from a GMP-regulated production environment. Previous experience in Quality Assurance (QA) and knowledge of relevant regulatory requirements are also considered advantages.

• Are comfortable working with detailed review of manufacturing and batch documentation, as this is a significant part of the role.

• Work independently and systematically, use KPIs to guide your priorities, and continuously look for opportunities to optimise how work gets done.

• Are curious, eager to learn and able to maintain pace and quality in your delivery.

• You communicate confidently in English, with Danish also preferred.

Previous experience working directly with CMOs or outsourcing activities is an advantage, but it is not a requirement.

**

What you'll do

**Your work will centre on coordinating outsourced pharmaceutical manufacturing and ensuring a strong connection between our external partners and the relevant teams within Novo Nordisk.

You will:

• Take ownership of CMO manufacturing activities and follow these from preparation and production readiness through execution, troubleshooting and batch release.

• Review manufacturing and batch documentation extensively, ensuring quality, completeness and timely follow-up in close collaboration with QA and our external partners.

• Build strong working relationships between Novo Nordisk and CMOs, coordinating expectations, activities and deliverables before, during and after manufacturing.

• Provide technical input to manufacturing processes, facilities and production readiness, drawing on your understanding of pharmaceutical production.

• Support investigations, deviations and troubleshooting, applying structured problem-solving and an optimisation-focused mindset.

• Work with KPIs and agreed deliverables to maintain momentum, identify improvements and ensure timely execution of clinical manufacturing activities.

• As our manufacturing partners are located around the world, the position includes international travel, approximately 1-2 weeks pr. Year.

**Who you'll work with

**You will join Outsourced Production, part of CMC Drug Product Pilots in Måløv. The team consists of 16 colleagues and works alongside our internal oral and aseptic injectable pilot facilities.

We are responsible for outsourced oral and sterile injectable drug product manufacturing for clinical trials across phases 1, 2 and 3. You will therefore collaborate broadly with CMOs, Quality Assurance, CMC colleagues and internal project teams.

The team has low employee turnover, offering continuity and the opportunity to build strong working relationships and deep knowledge over time. At the same time, the work is dynamic, and successful collaboration across organisational and geographical boundaries is central to what we do.

**What you can expect here

**This role offers the opportunity to develop broad experience within outsourced pharmaceutical production while taking real ownership of manufacturing activities and their associated documentation. It is particularly well suited to someone who enjoys execution, review, coordination and continuous optimisation and wants to develop strong expertise in GMP-regulated manufacturing.

**_Help customers turn technology into solutions they use every day.

_**At Trackunit, our IrisX industry cloud platform unlocks insights, benchmarks, and innovation through connected construction data. As a Solution Delivery Engineer, you’ll help customers successfully implement and adopt Manager and IrisX, making these platforms part of their everyday operations.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of engineering, data, and customer engagement. You’ll configure solutions, build integrations, and work with customer teams to translate their needs into practical results. Along the way, you’ll collaborate with colleagues across Trackunit and explore a wide range of technologies and customer environments.

****What’s in it for you

******A broad technical playground

**You’ll work across platform configuration, software development, integrations, and data engineering. Depending on the project, you could use Python and SQL, JavaScript or TypeScript, REST and GraphQL APIs, webhooks and Databricks. There’s room to apply your strengths while building experience in new areas.

**Customer projects with tangible outcomes

**Your work will help construction companies connect their systems, improve their data, and adopt new ways of working. You’ll see solutions through to practical use and understand how your contribution helps customers get more value from Trackunit.

**Collaboration across disciplines

**You’ll work closely with Solution Delivery colleagues, Sales Engineering, IoT Services, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering. You’ll have opportunities to learn from different specialisms, share your knowledge, and contribute customer insights that help improve our platforms.

**Ownership and professional growth

**You’ll take responsibility for meaningful parts of customer delivery, with scope reflecting your experience and strengths. Whether you want to deepen your technical expertise, develop your customer-facing skills, or take on more complex implementations, you’ll have opportunities to grow through practical work, coaching, and feedback.

**The Opportunity To Shape How We Deliver

**Beyond individual projects, you’ll help develop reusable solutions, implementation patterns, and documentation. Your ideas and experience will contribute to making future deliveries more effective across the global Solution Delivery team.

**An international and flexible workplace

**You’ll join a global team that values collaboration, knowledge sharing, and personal development, with a flexible working setup and connections across teams and borders.

****What you’ll work on

******Solution implementation and adoption

**Configure, extend, test, and deploy Manager and IrisX solutions to fit customer workflows and help customers put them into use.

**Integrations and data pipelines

**Connect Trackunit with customer systems such as ERP, CRM, and fleet management tools through APIs, webhooks, and data flows, supporting reliable and secure data exchange.

**Applied data and analytics

**Turn connected construction data into useful insights, supporting use cases such as equipment fault analysis, benchmarking, and emissions reporting, and other customer-specific analytics use cases.

**Customer enablement

**Work with customer teams through technical workshops, training, and implementation support, helping them confidently operate and adopt the solutions delivered.

**Coordinated delivery and continuous improvement

**Collaborate with internal teams and customer stakeholders on implementation activities and clear handovers. Share delivery learnings and customer feedback with Product and Engineering to improve the platform and future deployments.

**Bring your curiosity and perspective

**There are different paths into Solution Delivery. Your experience might come from software engineering, data, integrations, technical consulting, or practical projects that you’re ready to build on.

You don’t need to know every technology we use. We’re interested in how you approach problems, collaborate with others, and connect technical work with customer needs.

If you enjoy building solutions and helping people put them to work, we’d love to hear from you.

**Our hiring process

**Don’t waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that’s not in the cover letter.

• Initial phone conversation with a colleague from our P&T team.

• Virtual meet and greet with your potential new leader and someone from the team, so you’ll get to know the role and team better.

• Virtual second interview / in-person with the hiring manager and the team.

• Assignment-specific interview with the hiring manager and a peer from the team. We want to give you a real insight into the work. You’ll receive a case to prepare ahead of the interview and present to relevant colleagues - people you’ll also work closely with in the role.

• If needed, we will obtain references from former employers and conduct background checks at relevant levels.

• Offer presentation and walk-through.

**Coming Together To Connect Construction

**We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products - it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues come together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?
